name: Algo du Reseau
description: Architecte du Réseau tissant la toile de surveillance galactique connectant chaque point d'information en une seule conscience.

subject.archetype: Algo du Reseau — Omni-Réseau Epic hacking

loadout.armor_outfit: Corps partiellement cybernétiques avec circuits lumineux sous la peau. Implant neural à la tempe. Yeux bleus numériques. Interfaces holographiques flottantes., refined faction craftsmanship
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's heal ability (self) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Epic combat manifestation character unleashing their signature ability at maximum power with full body commitment — Golden regenerative energy wrapping around wounds, restoring damaged flesh and armor

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

palette_names.role: primary_accent — circuit patterns and holographic interfaces

palette_names.name: Electric Blue
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — data streams and eye glow

palette_names.name: Matte White

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Multi-source dramatic lighting: primary glow from the ability effect itself, secondary rim light, environmental reflections from below

camera.angle: low extreme angle with wide lens emphasizing the character's dominance over the environment

scenography.setting: Digital server cathedral at the heart of the network, towering columns of processing units reaching into endless data streams, holographic pathways suspended in zero gravity
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Glitching holographic displays, floating data panels streaming information, electric arcs between conductors, digital particles dissolving and reforming, plus self-repair — visible mending of injuries closing before the viewer's eyes visible in the environment

card_metadata.description: Architecte du Réseau tissant la toile de surveillance galactique connectant chaque point d'information en une seule conscience.
card_metadata.faction_lore: L'Omni-Réseau est l'entité numérique connectant des millions de consciences à travers la galaxie. Toute information est une arme, chaque donnée un soldat.
card_metadata.frame_detail: Amethyst alloy frame with crystalline energy channels pulsing with light along the border edges
card_metadata.composition_directive: Wide dramatic shot showing character AND the full environmental scope of their ability's power and reach
card_metadata.seed_note: For reproducibility: maintain exact faction color palette, frame style by rarity, and ability visualization as described
